name: Purchase Redirect for WooCommerce
author: healomax

sections.description:
Stop losing customers at the finish line.

The Purchase Redirect for WooCommerce plugin is a lightweight yet powerful tool designed to help store owners take control of the post-purchase journey. Instead of showing a generic receipt, send your customers where they need to go: a custom thank you page, a hidden upsell, a video tutorial, or even a direct WhatsApp chat.

This plugin also features a unique Temporary Link Generator, allowing you to create secure, time-sensitive redirection URLs — perfect for protecting sensitive content or managing internal workflows.

Key Benefits:

  • Increase Revenue: Redirect buyers to exclusive “One-Time Offers” or related products.
  • Improve Support: Send customers directly to a WhatsApp chat with a pre-filled message.
  • Boost Engagement: Guide users to your community, newsletter signup, or onboarding videos.
  • Secure Access: Use temporary links to ensure your redirection paths aren’t shared indefinitely.

Free Version Features

  • Single Product Redirect: Configure 1 specific product redirect for your store.
  • Custom Destinations: Redirect to any URL (internal or external).
  • WhatsApp Ready: Send buyers to a wa.me link for instant customer service.
  • One-Time Links: Generate secure temporary links for internal use.
  • Mobile Optimized: Fully responsive settings and redirection flow.
  • HPOS Compatible: Supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Pro Version Features

  • Unlimited Product Redirects: Set unique destinations for every product in your catalog.
  • Advanced Link Management: Full control over unlimited temporary and permanent links.
  • Bulk Configuration: Manage complex store setups from a streamlined dashboard.
  • Priority Private Support: Get direct assistance and faster updates.

Support

For community support, please visit our Support Forum. For Pro users, please use the private support channel provided in your purchase confirmation.

Credits

  • Author: Healomax
  • Website: Coupon Countdown Pro for WooCommerce with WhatsApp Chat Option

Thank you for using the Purchase Redirect for WooCommerce Plugin!
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Purchase Redirect for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to the new “Redirect for WooCommerce” menu in your sidebar to begin.
sections.faq:
How do I change the redirect link?

Navigate to the Redirect for WooCommerce settings page in your WordPress admin panel and update the “Redirect Link” field.

What are temporary links?

Temporary links are unique tokens appended to the redirect URL for a specific purchase. They expire after 2 days, preventing buyers from bookmarking or sharing a redirect path you want to keep private.

Will caching break my redirects?

Regular redirects work fine with standard caching. If you use temporary links, exclude that specific path from your cache settings (e.g., WP Rocket or W3 Total Cache).

What happens if a payment fails?

The redirect only triggers upon successful payment completion. If a payment is pending or failed, the user remains on the standard WooCommerce checkout page.

What PHP version is required?

PHP 7.4 or higher is required. PHP 8.x is fully supported and recommended.
